name: audiorective
description: Web Audio toolkit for coding agents — reactive primitives, scheduling, parameter automation, DSP effects, and React, three.js, and PlayCanvas bindings. Two skills: `audiorective` teaches Claude to design and build synthesizers, sequencers, DAWs, audio visualizers, and spatial audio apps with correct audio/UI separation; `audio-processor-authoring` teaches it to write and review AudioProcessor subclasses.
